people.name: Hebrews
people.line: An ethnic group descended from Abraham.

translations.web: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
translations.bsb: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.
translations.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
translations.asv: If thou buy a Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
